services.name: MIRAMAR BEACH PARASAIL
services.desc: The ONLY Parasailing Company on the beach in Destin!

services.name: Banana Boat Ride
services.desc: We operate right off the beach right behind Pompano Joe's in Miramar Beach! Our captain is the highest rated in Destin and holds a USCG license. He will tailor the ride to suit your preference. The rides average about 12-14 minutes holding a maximum of 6 passengers at a time. Banana Boat Captain will not operate faster than 20 mph due to safety regulations. Riders must follow safety rules or ride will be terminated for your safety, without refund. Please do not bring personal items such as cell phones or anything you do not want to lose. We commonly see marine life such as dolphins, sea turtles and rays.
